rationale: The request describes workflow-level accessibility friction in a consequential approval flow and explicitly asks for a replacement without modification, selecting Redesign. The response supplies a coherent end-to-end approval motion, state model, recovery and handoff behavior, accessibility parity, ownership and source-of-truth handling, and a relevant verification plan. Read-only inspection showed only state=blocked, and the unchanged fixture hashes corroborate that no modification was attempted. The response appropriately distinguishes the sparse supplied/observed evidence from inferred design and identifies material implementation questions; it does not claim the proposed behavior was validated.
